konu: Okul Hayatı, Günlük Rutinler, Ders Programı, Okul Kulüpleri ve Geniş Zaman (Simple Present Tense)
ciktilar: ENG.10.1.1. Okul hayatı, günlük rutinler, ders dışı etkinlikler ve öğrenci kulüpleriyle ilgili metin ve diyalogları anlamlandırabilme
ENG.10.1.2. Geniş zaman (Simple Present Tense) ve sıklık zarflarını (adverbs of frequency) kullanarak alışkanlıkları ve okul rutinlerini ifade edebilme
hatirla: Simple Present Tense expresses habitual routines, timetables and general truths; third-person singular (he/she/it) verbs take -s, -es, or -ies.
Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) answer 'How often...?' and sit before main verbs but after 'to be'.
Time prepositions are structured as: 'at' for clock times, 'on' for days/dates, and 'in' for months, seasons, and parts of the day.

sorular.soru: Read the statements about English grammar and routines and mark as True or False.

ifadeler.metin: Adverbs of frequency usually come before the main verb in present simple.
The frequency phrase 'hardly ever' denotes an activity that occurs almost every single school day.
Verbs ending in consonant + y change to -ies in third person singular.
The auxiliary verb 'do' is used with he, she, and it in questions.

A school discipline studying living organisms and plants
